items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
OBSERVED GAME: Civ VI (Aztec, Montezuma), standard 500-turn game. Advanced from Turn 2/3960 BC to Turn 124/~175 AD over this session. Two cities founded: capital Tenochtitlan (pop ~6-7) and Atzcapotzalco (pop 2-4, founded south). No third city successfully founded (Settler kept dying/being captured; 'b' founding repeatedly failed).

CONTROLS LEARNED (empirically verified):
- Action command buttons (fortify/sleep/alert/skip/Move To) sit at pixel y~535 => normalized y~0.74, NOT 0.68. Early failures came from clicking too high (y~0.53). This coordinate fix unlocked unit orders.
- 'Sleep' (crescent moon) button reliably clears a unit's orders so turns can advance. Fortify shield (~0.80-0.82,0.74) also worked.
- 'Move To' (blue '>' arrow, ~0.73-0.78 at y~0.74) then clicking a dotted destination hex reliably moves a unit and clears its orders. Toggling Move To by re-clicking does NOT turn it off; a destination click is required.
- The big round '!' dial bottom-right (~0.92-0.94, 0.85-0.93) is 'unit needs orders' / reselects the pending unit OR is the NEXT TURN/globe dial. Clicking it when a unit still has orders just reselects that unit. The round spinning-globe dial bottom-right (~0.93,0.86) is the reliable turn-advance button; plain map clicks and label-clicks often fail.
- Production: clicking a city's row/gear opens production. Unit rows (Settler/Builder/Scout/Archer) queue reliably; DISTRICT rows (Holy Site/Encampment/Entertainment Complex) route into tile-placement/buy-tiles mode and usually fail to queue (avoid relying on them). Section headers collapse/expand; clicking a district header can hide the list. Right-edge clicks sometimes fall through to tile-purchase mode.
- Research/Civic: close the 'completed' card via its top-right X (~0.605,0.077), then CHOOSE RESEARCH/CHOOSE CIVIC (~0.937,0.737). Tech rows in research panel are lower than they look; in this 720px layout Masonry row icon ~y0.70. Selected techs often pick an adjacent row accidentally.
- Policies: drag cards into slots; Confirm Policies button at the very bottom edge (~0.75,0.985) is partially off-screen; clicking its sliver then 'Yes' on the confirm dialog worked.
- Escape opens/toggles the pause Menu; menu buttons often ignore clicks, but Escape again closes it. Escape also closes Civilopedia/City-States panels (their X buttons were unreliable).
- Advisor/Research/Unit-Captured/Wonder popups: OK/X often unresponsive to clicks; Escape then re-approach works.
- 'b' founds a city only on a valid tile (fresh water + not too close to another city); it silently fails otherwise.

ECONOMY/TECH: Researched Pottery, Animal Husbandry, Mining, Archery, Horseback Riding, Irrigation, Bronze Working, Sailing, Iron Working, Shipbuilding, Wheel; researching Masonry (7t) at end. Civics: Code of Laws, Foreign Trade, Mysticism, Craftsmanship, Military Tradition, Early Empire, State Workforce, Political Philosophy, Drama and Poetry, Games and Recreation; adopting Defensive Tactics. Government switched to Oligarchy (Discipline, Agoge, Urban Planning, God King policies). Pantheon: Desert Folklore (accidentally committed; River Goddess was the intended amenity fix). One envoy each to Kumasi and Brussels. Gold ~830, science ~+22, culture ~+9.

RECURRING PROBLEM (unresolved): A massive barbarian horde (~8-12 red Warrior/Archer units, plus camps) has besieged both cities for many turns. They are contained at the borders but never wiped out; cities hold (defense strength) but barbarians repeatedly capture any undefended Builder/Settler left in the open. Multiple Builders captured this way. City amenities are negative (-1/-2), stunting growth. Improvement-card clicks in a Builder's panel consistently only HOVER (show tooltips like 'Build Improvement: Camp/Farm/Pasture/Fishing Boats') and never start a build; outcome uncertain whether this is an invalid-tile issue or a UI quirk. Sleep/Move To is used to clear Builder orders and advance turns instead. State at cutoff: Turn 124, Scout selected (2/3 movement) needing orders; just entered Move To and clicked a destination dot (~0.62,0.573) east of the Scout; result pending.
